description: This file defines the DateOps class for handling date-related operations in pandas-on-Spark, including date subtraction and comparison operators, with support for type conversion.

classes.name: DateOps
classes.description: Class for binary operations on pandas-on-Spark objects with Spark DateType, including date subtraction and comparison.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Performs date subtraction, returning the difference in days as a long integer, with warnings about behavior differences from pandas.

methods.name: rsub
methods.description: Performs reverse date subtraction, returning the negative difference in days.

methods.name: astype
methods.description: Converts the data type of the date series, supporting categorical, boolean, string, and other types.
